question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored object is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done always.
The power to shake the triple world is stated.
inference: Continual contemplation of a smoke-colored form grants the power to shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
